name: Fixed Recursive
tagline: Isolate weight sharing, without routing or conditioning.
description: A shared-core control baseline. Every token traverses the same core twice, isolating the effect of parameter sharing and providing a control for the additional mechanisms used by adaptive looped models.
mechanism: The shared core and its Value Embeddings are reused together
Full backpropagation through time with language-model loss only
limitations: A project control baseline, rather than a full reproduction of an individual Recursive Transformers paper.
